   304           *      If the data is variable length i.e. strings or octets
   305           *      there is a length field before each element.
   306           *
   307           *   +-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-...-+-+-+-+-+-+-+

   312                  if ((end - p) < 2) {
   313                  raw:

   315                          if (slen < 0) return slen;
   316                          break;
   317                  }
   318
   319                  element_len = fr_net_to_uint16(p);
   320                  if ((p + 2 + element_len) > end) {
   321                          goto raw;
   322                  }
   323
   324                  p += 2;
   325                  slen = decode_value(ctx, cursor, dict, parent, p, element_len, decode_ctx);
   326                  if (slen < 0) return slen;
   327                  p += slen;
   328          }

   330          return data_len;

   334  static ssize_t decode_dns_labels(TALLOC_CTX *ctx, fr_dcursor_t *cursor, fr_dict_t const *dict,
   335                                   fr_dict_attr_t const *parent,
   336                                   uint8_t const *data, size_t const data_len, void *decode_ctx)
   337  {
   338          ssize_t slen;
   339          size_t total, labels_len;
   340          fr_pair_t *vp;
   341          uint8_t const *next = data;
   342          fr_dns_ctx_t *packet_ctx = decode_ctx;
   343
   344          FR_PROTO_HEX_DUMP(data, data_len, "decode_dns_labels");
   345
   346          /*
   347           *      This function handles both single-valued and array
   348           *      types.  It's just easier that way.
   349           */
   350          if (!parent->flags.array) {
   351                  /*
   352                   *      Decode starting at "NEXT", but allowing decodes from the start of the packet.
   353                   */
   354                  slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);
   355                  if (slen <= 0) {
   356                          FR_PROTO_TRACE("length failed at %zd - %s", slen, fr_strerror());
   357                          goto raw;
   358                  }
   359
   360                  labels_len = next - data; /* decode only what we've found */
   361          } else {
   362                  /*
   363                   *      Get the length of the entire set of labels, up
   364                   *      to (and including) the final 0x00.
   365                   *
   366                   *      If any of the labels point outside of this
   367                   *      area, OR they are otherwise invalid, then that's an error.
   368                   */
   369                  slen = fr_dns_labels_network_verify(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, data, packet_ctx->lb);
   370                  if (slen < 0) {
   371                          FR_PROTO_TRACE("verify failed");
   372                  raw:
   373                          return decode_raw(ctx, cursor, dict, parent, data, data_len, decode_ctx);
   374                  }
   375
   376                  labels_len = slen;
   377          }
   378
   379          /*
   380           *      Loop over the input buffer, decoding the labels one by
   381           *      one.
   382           */
   383          for (total = 0; total < labels_len; total += slen) {
   384                  vp = fr_pair_afrom_da(ctx, parent);
   385                  if (!vp) return PAIR_DECODE_OOM;
   386
   387                  /*
   388                   *      Having verified the input above, this next
   389                   *      function should never fail unless there's a
   390                   *      bug in the code.
   391                   */
   392                  slen = fr_dns_label_to_value_box(vp, &vp->data, data, labels_len, data + total, true, packet_ctx->lb);
   393                  if (slen <= 0) {
   394                          FR_PROTO_TRACE("Failed decoding label at %zd", slen);
   395                          talloc_free(vp);
   396                          goto raw;
   397                  }
   398
   399                  vp->type = VT_DATA;
   400                  fr_dcursor_append(cursor, vp);
   401          }
   402
   403          FR_PROTO_TRACE("decode_dns_labels - %zu", labels_len);
   404          return labels_len;
   405  }

   407  static ssize_t decode_record(TALLOC_CTX *ctx, fr_dcursor_t *cursor, fr_dict_attr_t const *attr,
   408                               uint8_t const *packet, size_t packet_len,
   409                               fr_dns_ctx_t *packet_ctx, uint8_t const *counter)
   410  {
   411          int i, count;
   412          uint8_t const *p, *end;
   413
   414          p = packet;
   415          end = packet + packet_len;
   416
   417          count = fr_net_to_uint16(counter);
   418          FR_PROTO_TRACE("Decoding %u of %s", count, attr->name);
   419          for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   420                  ssize_t slen;
   421
   422                  FR_PROTO_HEX_DUMP(p, end - p, "fr_dns_decode - %s %d/%d", attr->name, i, count);
   423
   424                  if (p >= end) {
   425                          FR_PROTO_TRACE("%s overflows packet at %d", attr->name, i);
   426                          return -(p - packet);
   427                  }
   428
   429                  slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr, p, end - p, true,
   430                                                packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);
   431                  if (slen < 0) return slen;
   432                  p += slen;
   433          }
   434
   435          return p - packet;
   436  }

   438  /** Decode a DNS packet
   439   *
   440   */
   441  ssize_t fr_dns_decode(TALLOC_CTX *ctx, uint8_t const *packet, size_t packet_len, fr_dcursor_t *cursor, fr_dns_ctx_t *packet_ctx)
   442  {
   443          ssize_t                 slen;
   444          uint8_t const           *p, *end;
   445
   446          FR_PROTO_TRACE("HERE %d", __LINE__);
   447
   448          if (packet_len < DNS_HDR_LEN) return 0;
   449
   450          /*
   451           *      @todo - synthesize Packet-Type from the various fields.
   452           */
   453
   454          FR_PROTO_HEX_DUMP(packet, packet_len, "fr_dns_decode");
   455
   456          /*
   457           *      Decode the header.
   458           */
   459          slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_packet, packet, DNS_HDR_LEN, true,
   460                                        packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);
   461          if (slen < 0) {
   462          fail:
   463                  fr_strerror_const("Failed decoding DNS packet");
   464                  return slen;
   465          }
   466
   467          p = packet + DNS_HDR_LEN;
   468          end = packet + packet_len;
   469
   470          slen = decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_question, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 4);
   880   */
   881  ssize_t fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(uint8_t const *packet, uint8_t const *buf, size_t buf_len, uint8_t const **next, fr_dns_labels_t *lb)
   882  {
   883          uint8_t const *p, *q, *end, *label_end;
   884          uint8_t const *current, *start;
   885          size_t length;
   886          bool at_first_label, already_set_next;
   887
   888          if (!packet || !buf || (buf_len == 0) || !next) {
   889                  fr_strerror_printf("Invalid argument");
   890                  return 0;
   891          }
   892
   893          start = *next;
   894
   895          /*
   896           *      Don't allow stupidities
   897           */
   898          if (!((start >= packet) && (start < (buf + buf_len)))) {
   899                  fr_strerror_printf("Label is not within the buffer");
   900                  return 0;
   901          }
   902
   903          end = buf + buf_len;
   904          p = current = start;
   905          length = 0;
   906          at_first_label = true;
   907          already_set_next = false;
   908
   909          /*
   910           *      We silently accept labels *without* a trailing 0x00,
   911           *      so long as they end at the end of the input buffer.
   912           */
   913          while (p < end) {
   914                  /*
   915                   *      End of label byte.  Skip it.
   916                   *
   917                   *      Empty labels are length 1, to account for the
   918                   *      '.'.  The caller has to take care of this
   919                   *      manually.
   920                   */
   921                  if (*p == 0x00) {
   922                          p++;
   923                          if (at_first_label) length++;
   924
   925                          /*
   926                           *      We're still processing the first
   927                           *      label, tell the caller where the next
   928                           *      one is located.
   929                           */
   930                          if (current == start) {
   931                                  *next = p;
   932                                  already_set_next = true;
   933                          }
   934
   935                          break;
   936                  }
   937
   938                  /*
   939                   *      0b10 and 0b10 are forbidden
   940                   */
   941                  if ((*p > 63) && (*p < 0xc0)) {
   942                          fr_strerror_const("Data with invalid high bits");
   943                          return -(p - buf);
   944                  }
   945
   946                  /*
   947                   *      Maybe it's a compressed pointer.
   948                   */
   949                  if (*p > 63) {
   950                          uint16_t offset;
   951
   952                          if ((p + 2) > end) {
   953                          overflow:
   954                                  fr_strerror_const("Label overflows buffer");
   955                                  return -(p - buf);
   956                          }
   957
   958                          offset = p[1];
   959                          offset += ((*p & ~0xc0) << 8);
   960
   961                          /*
   962                           *      Forward references are forbidden,
   963                           *      including self-references.
   964                           *
   965                           *      This requirement follows RFC 1035
   966                           *      Section 4.1.4, which says:
   967                           *
   968                           *      ... an entire domain name or a list of
   969                           *      labels at the end of a domain name is
   970                           *      replaced with a pointer to a prior
   971                           *      occurance of the same name.
   972                           *      ...
   973                           *
   974                           *      Note the key word PRIOR.  If we
   975                           *      enforce that the pointer is backwards,
   976                           *      and do various other enforcements,
   977                           *      then it is very difficult for
   978                           *      attackers to create malicious DNS
   979                           *      packets which will cause the decoder
   980                           *      to do bad things.
   981                           */
   982                          if (offset >= (p - packet)) {
   983                                  fr_strerror_printf("Pointer %04x at offset %04x is an invalid forward reference",
   984                                                     offset, (int) (p - buf));
   985                                  return -(p - buf);
   986                          }
   987
   988                          /*
   989                           *      If we're tracking which labels are
   990                           *      valid, then check the pointer, too.
   991                           */
   992                          if (!dns_pointer_valid(lb, offset)) {
   993                                  fr_strerror_printf("Pointer %04x at offset %04x does not point to a DNS label",
   994                                                     offset, (int) (p - buf));
   995                                  return -(p - buf);
   996                          }
   997
   998                          q = packet + offset;
   999
  1000                          /*
  1001                           *      As an additional sanity check, the
  1002                           *      pointer MUST NOT point to something
  1003                           *      within the label we're parsing.  If
  1004                           *      that happens, we have a loop.
  1005                           *
  1006                           *      i.e. the pointer must point backwards
  1007                           *      to *before* our current label.  When
  1008                           *      that limitation is enforced, pointer
  1009                           *      loops are impossible.
  1010                           */
  1011                          if (q >= current) {
  1012                                  fr_strerror_printf("Pointer %04x at offset %04x creates a loop within a label",
  1013                                                     offset, (int) (p - buf));
  1014                                  return -(p - buf);
  1015                          }
  1016
  1017                          /*
  1018                           *      The pointer MUST point to a valid
  1019                           *      length field, and not to another
  1020                           *      pointer.
  1021                           */
  1022                          if (*q > 63) {
  1023                                  fr_strerror_printf("Pointer %04x at offset %04x does not point to the start of a label",
  1024                                                     offset, (int) (p - buf));
  1025                                  return -(p - buf);
  1026                          }
  1027
  1028                          /*
  1029                           *      The pointer MUST NOT point to an end of label field.
  1030                           */
  1031                          if (!*q) {
  1032                                  fr_strerror_printf("Pointer %04x at offset %04x refers to an invalid field", offset,
  1033                                                     (int) (p - buf));
  1034                                  return -(p - buf);
  1035                          }
  1036
  1037                          /*
  1038                           *      If we're jumping away from the label
  1039                           *      we started with, tell the caller where
  1040                           *      the next label is in the network
  1041                           *      buffer.
  1042                           */
  1043                          if (current == start) {
  1044                                  *next = p + 2;
  1045                                  already_set_next = true;
  1046                          }
  1047
  1048                          p = current = q;
  1049                          continue;
  1050                  }
  1051
  1052                  /*
  1053                   *      Else it's an uncompressed label
  1054                   */
  1055                  if ((p + *p + 1) > end) goto overflow;
  1056
  1057                  /*
  1058                   *      Account for the '.' on every label after the
  1059                   *      first one.
  1060                   */
  1061                  if (!at_first_label) length++;
  1062                  at_first_label = false;
  1063                  length += *p;
  1064
  1065                  /*
  1066                   *      DNS names can be no more than 255 octets.
  1067                   */
  1068                  if (length > 255) {
  1069                          fr_strerror_const("Total length of labels is > 255");
  1070                          return -(p - buf);
  1071                  }
  1072
  1073                  q = p + 1;
  1074                  label_end = q + *p;
  1075
  1076                  /*
  1077                   *      Allow for underscore at the beginning of a
  1078                   *      label.
  1079                   */
  1080                  if (*q == '_') q++;
  1081
  1082                  /*
  1083                   *      Verify that the contents of the label are OK.
  1084                   */
  1085                  while (q < label_end) {
  1086                          if (!((*q == '-') || ((*q >= '0') && (*q <= '9')) ||
  1087                                ((*q >= 'A') && (*q <= 'Z')) || ((*q >= 'a') && (*q <= 'z')))) {
  1088                                  fr_strerror_printf("Invalid character 0x%02x in label", *q);
  1089                                  return -(q - buf);
  1090                          }
  1091
  1092                          q++;
  1093                  }
  1094
  1095                  p += *p + 1;
  1096          }
  1097
  1098          /*
  1099           *      Return the length of this label.
  1100           */
  1101          if (!already_set_next) *next = p; /* should be <='end' */
  1102
  1103          (void) dns_label_add(lb, start, *next);
  1104
  1105          return length;
  1106  }

  1108  /** Verify that a network buffer contains valid DNS labels.
  1109   *
  1110   * @param[in] packet      where the packet starts
  1111   * @param[in] buf       buffer holding one or more DNS labels
  1112   * @param[in] buf_len   total length of the buffer
  1113   * @param[in] start     where to start looking
  1114   * @param[in] lb        label tracking data structure
  1115   * @return
  1116   *      - <=0 on error, where in the buffer the invalid label is located.
  1117   *      - > 0 total size of the encoded label(s).  Will be <= buf_len
  1118   */
  1119  ssize_t fr_dns_labels_network_verify(uint8_t const *packet, uint8_t const *buf, size_t buf_len, uint8_t const *start, fr_dns_labels_t *lb)
  1120  {
  1121          ssize_t slen;
  1122          uint8_t const *label = start;
  1123          uint8_t const *end = buf + buf_len;
  1124
  1125          while (label < end) {
  1126                  if (*label == 0x00) {
  1127                          label++;
  1128                          break;
  1129                  }
  1130
  1131                  slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet, buf, buf_len, &label, lb);
  1132                  if (slen <= 0) return slen; /* already is offset from 'buf' and not 'label' */
  1133          }
  1134
  1135          return label - buf;
  1136  }

  1164           */

  1166          *next = p + *p + 1;
